question: Sitar maestro, Pandit Ravi Shankar was awarded which of the following awards by the Government of India in 1999?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Ratna**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1999, **Pandit Ravi Shankar was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor**
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar was a renowned sitar player**, composer, and musician.
 
• He **was known for popularizing the sitar around the world **and becoming **a leading exponent of North Indian classical music in the second half of the 20th century.**
 
• He **also collaborated with the Beatles and won three Grammy Awards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shr**i

 
 
• India's **fourth-highest civilian award.**
 
• It is **conferred for distinguished contributions in fields like art, education, science, literature, medicine, social service, and public affairs.**
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**
 
 
• India's third-highest civilian award.
 
• It is awarded for distinguished service of a high order.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• Given for e**xceptional and distinguished service.**
 
• It is India's second-highest civilian award.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna**
 
 
• India's highest civilian award.
 
• It is conferred for exceptional service or performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavour.
 
 
 
• These awards are announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day (January 26)**, and they are presented by the **President of India** in a ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan, usually in **March or April**.4
 
• The **Padma Awards** were instituted in **1954**.
 
• Hockey legend **Balbir Singh Dosanjh** was the first sportsperson to receive the **Padma Shri** for his achievements in hockey.
